prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG illustration of the ASCENDED Briar Mantis, a proposed Last Hearth expansion creature. One subject only, one finished scene, visual development with no canonical history or gameplay rules. Canvas/viewBox 1024x720. One top-level group id=mantis-ascended beginning with a full-canvas #172928 background rectangle. Complete subject/support inside x=64..960,y=54..666. No labels, text, stats, borders, logos, watermark or UI.
CONTINUITY: same leaf-green praying mantis as the normal family design: slim elongated diagonal prothorax, narrow closed-to-partly-open leaf wing covers over a long tapered abdomen, triangular head turned toward viewer, small inset compound eyes and two long curved antennae. Sage #789579 and deeper leaf greens, ivory #dfd4b4 upper-left light, small ochre-brass #c5a76a joint accents. Natural chitin, not metallic assembly. A SHORT VISIBLE TAPERED CERVICAL SEGMENT must overlap and connect the posterior head to the prothorax: absolutely no floating head or empty neck gap. Foreleg coxae connect to the prothorax; four walking legs attach around the middle/hind thoracic body junction, not random points on the abdomen. Six legs total, two raptorial forelegs plus four supporting walking legs. Antennae are not legs.
ASCENDED GESTURE: an outward reaching sentinel on a low forked branch with two support levels. Whole body leans forward across the open fork; abdomen sweeps back and up, rather than sitting in the normal's straight horizontal side profile. One large raptorial foreleg opens diagonally upward and forward with its claw bent inward; the other remains close and folded in front of the chest. Keep their gestures clearly unequal. Four walking feet visibly grip the two branch levels, with clear load-bearing contact and big spaces between limbs. Lift the narrow wing covers into two unequal leaf-like planes behind the thorax, still attached to the abdomen root; do not replace them with giant butterfly wings. Frame the complete head, antennae, claws, abdomen and feet. This pose must change support, body angle and silhouette, not just add gold, a halo, ornament or a mirrored normal.
STYLE: expressive engraved fantasy illustration grounded in Hearth's natural creature art. Continuous organic chitin curves and tapered articulated limbs, broad three-value planes before sparse engraving. Distinct head/thorax/abdomen volumes connected through believable joints. Small fitted eyes, never mascot beads. Quiet dark forest field, no dense scenery, plastic gloss, repeated hatching or all-gold edging. Aim for economical editable geometry, roughly 55-85 filled paths as a soft target, without sacrificing anatomy. Identity and gesture must read at 160x112 and 64x45; do not depend on tiny spines or textures. No human shoulders, mammal neck, stiff tubes, detached joint caps or stacked blobs.
OUTPUT: true static native vector paths and simple shapes, explicit flat paints. No raster/image elements, external resources, scripts, animation, use references, defs, filters or gradients. No emblem, chart, extra panels or second creature.
